html:
G'oya

Ketma-ket kunlarni topishning mashhur usuli: kunni uning tartib raqami bilan solishtirish. Seriya ichida kun ham, ROW_NUMBER ham bittadan o'sadi, ayirmasi esa o'zgarmaydi. Uzilish bo'lsa, kun ko'proq sakraydi va ayirma o'zgaradi. Demak ayirmasi bir xil kunlar bitta seriya, qolgani guruhlab sanash.

Yechim

WITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, day FROM logins
),
grp AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         day - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY day) AS g
  FROM days
)
SELECT user_id, MAX(cnt) AS longest_streak
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, g, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY user_id, g
) s
GROUP BY user_id

Namunada 1-foydalanuvchi 3, 4, 5, 8, 9-kunlarda kirgan. Tartib raqamlari 1 dan 5 gacha, ayirmalar 2, 2, 2, 4, 4: uzunligi 3 va 2 bo'lgan ikki seriya, javob 3. Ayirmaning qiymati hech narsani anglatmaydi, u faqat seriyaning yorlig'i.

Tuzoqlar

Bir kundagi takroriy kirishlar. ROW_NUMBER ularga har xil raqam beradi va ayirma seriya o'rtasida o'zgarib ketadi. 3, 4, 4, 5-kunlar uchun ayirmalar 2, 2, 1, 1 chiqadi va uch kunlik seriya ikkiga bo'linib qoladi. Shuning uchun avval DISTINCT:

Noto'g'riWITH grp AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         day - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY day) AS g
  FROM logins
)
SELECT user_id, MAX(cnt) AS longest_streak
FROM (SELECT user_id, g, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM grp GROUP BY user_id, g) s
GROUP BY user_id

Faol kunlar soni seriya emas: 1, 3, 5-kunlarda kirgan foydalanuvchining eng uzun seriyasi 1. Eng uzun seriya boshida bo'lishi ham shart emas, shuning uchun birinchi guruh emas, MAX olinadi.
